resources.string: StreamTrack TV needs three permissions. Each one opens the TV\'s own settings screen; come back here when done.
Lets the app read how long each app is in the foreground, and when the screen is on.
An accessibility service that counts remote presses by class. It cannot read the screen or what you type.
Keeps the hourly sync running while the TV is in standby.
This TV has no settings screen for this. Run the command below from a computer with adb, then come back:
Foreground time per app and hour, with the app\'s name
Number of remote presses per hour and key class
Which key was pressed, beyond its class
Text you type, passwords or search queries
Screen content, screenshots or window titles
What you watch inside an app: titles, channels or URLs
Location, microphone, camera, contacts or accounts
Advertising IDs or any data for third parties
